notes: Synthetic values only. Send x-waldo-app-contract: health=9 (or later) to GET /app/v1/health/signals?signal=<one>&days=7|30|90; a build below revision 9 gets no such route (404), and the route is also absent while the server's switch is off.

Each day's value is the number the owner's scores used for that day: the same reduction of the same readings, from the source the scores took for the day (source says which). It is not a second derivation, so the app draws it and never recomputes it.

A day with no value is left out of days, so a chart shows a gap and never a zero. days is oldest first, inside from..to, which spans window_days ending on the owner's own today (the zone of their newest reading).
method is the reading's method where it has one (the HRV method, the resting-rate method, absolute or baseline_delta for wrist temperature) and null otherwise; never mix methods in one line.
used_in says which scores the signal feeds. An empty list means it feeds none (stage minutes, efficiency): a chart of it is information, never an input to a score.
hours is today's hourly values, oldest first, for the three signals made of hourly windows (daylight, movement, active_energy). Those three are served to 30 days; days=90 for them is a 400.

usual is the owner's usual for this signal as of today, exactly as /scores serves it (revision 8), and only while the usual is served; a signal with no band (sleep_asleep, the stages, sleep_efficiency) has none.
sleep_asleep and the stage minutes come from the night's asleep reading, whether or not a score used that night; sleep_midpoint is the one the scores used.
Not served yet: steps, VO2 max, heart rate and HRV by the hour.
